status: Exploratory stage2 designed after stage1 result; not independent confirmation.
method: Symmetric InfoNCE aligns molecular Morgan fingerprint and hashed MOA text; trainable linear24-d projections, frozen inputs. Does not reproduce MAP BioBERT/MoleculeSTM/ESM2 or gene-token transformer.
training: Up to2048unique canonical structures with nonempty MOA, exclude all146menu drug names; deterministic hash ordering; last256heldout drug structures not in training; 25epochs,batch128,Adam0.003,temperature0.1,seed20261008. No response labels.
downstream: Fixed same24drug representation dimensions; structure24,randomknowledge24,contrastive24,contrastive_permuted24; unchanged stage1 reference selection and target evaluation rules.
